maddeler.e:
ننبسط (form VII)
# نَنْبَسِطُ (nanbasiṭu) /nan.ba.si.tˤu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْبَسَطَ (inbasaṭa)
# نَنْبَسِطَ (nanbasiṭa) /nan.ba.si.tˤa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْبَسَطَ (inbasaṭa)
# نَنْبَسِطْ (nanbasiṭ) /nan.ba.sitˤ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْبَسَطَ (inbasaṭa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
